purpose: Reconstruct the six-point MACS J1206 BCG line-of-sight velocity-dispersion profile from public calibrated spectra without using Figure 2 as numerical input.
blindness_rule: Freeze spatial masks, spectral masks, templates, resolution treatment, uncertainty calculation, and success thresholds before comparing reconstructed dispersions with the publication figure or any gravity residual.

input.astrometric_registration: fit the fixed-n=4.05, fixed-q, fixed-PA continuum model robustly and treat the offset from the published sky coordinate as a global cube-WCS correction

mask_protocol.stage_1: mask non-finite DATA/STAT values and non-positive variance
mask_protocol.stage_2: construct a white-light image from the median over 6000-7000 Angstrom
mask_protocol.stage_3: subtract a 3-pixel Gaussian-smoothed white-light image to form a compact-source detection image
mask_protocol.stage_4: flag positive compact residual components above 6 robust sigma with 2-300 connected pixels, excluding the registered central 3.0 arcsec
mask_protocol.stage_5: dilate flagged components by 8 pixels to remove source wings and freeze the resulting mask before spectral fitting

spectral_fit.mask_high_variance_pixels: exclude wavelength planes whose annular variance median exceeds the local 21-pixel median by 6 robust sigma
spectral_fit.noise_model: sum STAT variance over unmasked spaxels; rescale formal noise to unit robust residual variance only for reported conditional errors

covariance_protocol.spatial_resampling: 100 deterministic spatial block-bootstrap replicates within each annulus using 2x2-spaxel blocks
covariance_protocol.template_systematic: repeat with XSL templates if available; otherwise mark this component missing rather than treating it as zero
covariance_protocol.reported_covariance: sum the bootstrap covariance and between-protocol covariance; preserve all six-by-six off-diagonal terms

success_thresholds.publication_figure_use: visual validation only after all preceding outputs are frozen
